# Phase One — Chesed Boundless Brainstorm

The Awtsmoos gives possibility without boundary or wall; Awtsmoos.com lets one semantic movie language become a vessel wide enough for all.

## Five competing architectures
### A — Universal monolithic movie app
One app absorbs Animator, Nesher, Video Editor and Mitzvah Studio. Rejected: destroys app personality, raises coupling and migration risk.

### B — Shared renderer only
Apps keep unrelated project models but share export. Rejected: AI still cannot reason over one movie language and cross-app edits lose semantics.

### C — Shared protocol plus app adapters
Canonical renderer-neutral project, explicit capabilities, fidelity reports and app-specific projections. Strong candidate.

### D — Event-sourced movie graph
Every edit is a command/event and current movie state is a projection. Powerful for collaboration/undo but heavy as the first persistence model.

### E — Shared protocol plus patch journal
Canonical snapshot plus reversible patch operations and optional history. Chosen: gives practical AI revision/undo now while leaving an event-sourced future open.

## Ideal feature universe
- Arbitrary duration from a one-second bumper to feature-length work.
- 2D, 3D and hybrid scenes in one schema.
- Real semantic media: image, video, audio, dialogue, narration, music, ambience, SFX and captions.
- Masks, mattes, adjustment layers, groups, parenting, transforms and camera tracks.
- Characters with stable cast IDs, wardrobe, props, emotion, gaze, gesture, action, pose and lipsync cues.
- Tutorial and infographic primitives with datasets, diagrams, callouts, code, steps and progress.
- AI plans movie -> acts -> scenes -> shots -> layers; revisions become narrow patches.
- Adapters declare exact preserved, flattened, deferred and rejected semantics.
- Mobile UX begins with directing intent, not JSON.
- Renderer interfaces allow Canvas proof, WebGL/WebGPU spatial preview and headless export to coexist.
- Assets carry hashes, provenance, proxy/original relationships and generated-seed metadata.
- Every export carries a reproducible manifest.
- Tests can fuzz malformed AI movies, migrate old movies, round-trip adapters and sample golden frames.
